accepted_temporal_and_persistence_contra: Freeze a single full-family choice for Y from exactly complete Y-2/Y-1 populations with fixed tie order and failure threshold; no variant retuning or 2025 outcome selection.
Every new state-changing trajectory retains complete own from-2010 history, original-origin raw means, original delayed-delivery/retention semantics and fixed 12/24-hour information boundaries.
Authenticate reused source bytes and exact semantic lineage/input/target/native-reason relationships; state is independently index-bound, and all earlier-delivered row contents remain immutable.
Pass the bank only validated history/targets fields. Keep receipt metadata in the controller and target outcomes in the grader. Durably publish the whole origin before grading.
Abort after any delivery validation error instead of retrying a partly mutated instance. Preserve same-game matching-variant/delay N0 fallback and native failures on all issued rows.

The total clock starts before source/runtime/admission/smoke/recovery/trajectory work. Pilot t1/t2 include all origin work, and callback timing has no overlapping attribution. The noncallback remainder includes cache/closures/selection/state/mass CDF/persistence work.

The actual hard deadline/RSS gate remains authoritative even if the conservative projection passes. No scientific callback continues after stop, and only metadata finalization may use the fixed grace.
One new identity and one atomic terminal/index completion pair, with mutually exclusive valid/invalid publication and retained ordinary/staging prefixes; no restart or competing terminal.
Independent implementation and actual-terminal reviews remain mandatory. No research label activates shadow/production, proves the external five-percent target or creates prospective evidence.
implementation_acceptance_obligations: Demonstrate actual fixture generation plus full public evaluation within the fixed 600-second integration limit; design acceptance does not predict that runtime or permit reduced rows/bootstrap work if it fails.

Treat selection.innerScoreSeasons [2011,2024] as inclusive year bounds as explicitly specified by the protocol, and verify every complete year/population rather than reading only the two endpoint seasons.

Resolve 2011–2012 inner N0 fallbacks from authenticated full_setting_forecasts N0 setting 0; no outer-selected N0 artifact exists for those warmup-inner years. All fixed fallback source memberships must be tested.
Enforce streaming and per-origin hash checks without retaining the entire parsed 1.862GB parent archive; measure actual process/child memory if a subprocess is used.
If smoke is a child process, termination/clock/RSS accounting must cover its lifetime and prevent continued scientific work after parent stop.

Test successful nonfallback pilot samples, finite positive F/S/G/N/T values, disjoint timer accounting including exceptions, exact future-origin sum, archive reuse branches, and no-eligible/failure paths.

Exercise public evaluator numeric-type/persistence boundaries and swallowed-deadline/late-fsync/uncommitted-prefix failure cases in the final real controller; do not inherit a success claim from pure-unit tests.
